why_ai: Screen-only agency work with no licence; testing platforms and AI absorb setup, analysis and variant building.
why_clarity: Uplift is measurable in principle, but reported wins are noisy and nobody checks they replicate.
why_digital: Web traffic data in, code variants and reports out, sold to clients remotely.

why_ai: Test setup, QA, sample-ratio checks and archiving are repetitive steps software automates directly.
why_clarity: The same operational checklist recurs on every test with objective pass or fail checks.
why_digital: Configured and monitored entirely inside testing platforms.

why_ai: A randomised holdback is standard infrastructure and analysis that tooling can run unattended.
why_clarity: The holdback gives an exact programme effect, but it runs once per programme over months.
why_digital: Traffic split and analysis happen entirely in software.

why_ai: Choosing which observation reflects a real mechanism is ambiguous, but LLMs are good at framing mechanisms.
why_clarity: Each strategist judges hypotheses by feel, and test results confirm them only noisily.
why_digital: Session recordings and heatmaps in, test proposals out, all on screen.

why_ai: Monthly reports assembled from platform data are directly generated by software.
why_clarity: Structured records of tests and results are exact and recur for every experiment.
why_digital: Platform data in, retrievable digital records out.

why_ai: Power, stopping rules and multiplicity guardrails are codified statistics platforms can enforce by default.
why_clarity: Experiment design rules are textbook and checkable before each test launches.
why_digital: Design and analysis happen entirely in software.

why_ai: Portfolio prioritisation by expected detectable effect is a decision models can increasingly make.
why_clarity: Allocation quality is visible only after tests conclude, and selection criteria vary by firm.
why_digital: Traffic and backlog data in, test roadmaps out, all remote.

why_ai: Writing injected JavaScript variants is code AI agents generate and test across browsers.
why_clarity: A variant must render as specified, though breakage surfaces only when the client ships.
why_digital: Code in, code out, entirely on screen.

why_ai: The strategist carries the client relationship and judges result reliability under commercial pressure.
why_clarity: Clients want a win while real effects are uncertain, so success is contested.
why_digital: Remote analysis and reporting, with relationship meetings that are mostly online.

why_ai: Validity checks are statistical methodology that software and AI can apply programme-wide.
why_clarity: Real uplift is definable and methods are known, but replication is rarely observed.
why_digital: Experiment data in, validated reports out, all on screen.

why_ai: Flicker, layout breaks and tracking gaps are detectable automatically and fixable by server-side delivery.
why_clarity: Implementation artefacts are measurable and recur on every variant.
why_digital: Live web pages and scripts, entirely digital.
